column3: User checks the Stats tab from empty, then after creating, completing and deleting tasks
column4:
1. Launch the app with cargo run
2. Press Shift+Right
3. Press Shift+Left, then create Overdue (due 2020-01-01), Open A and Open B (no dates) and Finish me and Bin me (no dates)
4. Complete Finish me with d and Enter; delete Bin me with - and Enter
5. Press Shift+Right
column5:
2. Four panels titled 'Overdue', 'ToDo', 'Done' and 'Deleted' each show a large 0; ToDo is yellow and the others are cyan
3. All five tasks are listed
4. Three tasks remain: Overdue, Open A and Open B
5. 'Overdue' shows a large red 1, 'ToDo' a yellow 3, 'Done' a cyan 1 and 'Deleted' a cyan 1

column3: User sees today's activity on the New Tasks chart
column4:
1. Launch the app with cargo run
2. Press Shift+Right and look at the middle panel
3. Press Shift+Left, create Chart A and Chart B (no dates), complete Chart A with d and Enter
4. Press Shift+Right
column5:
2. A panel titled 'New Tasks' shows a chart with the axis titles 'Days ago' and 'Count' and flat lines along the bottom
3. Only Chart B is listed
4. The yellow line rises at the right-hand (today) end of the chart and the cyan line also rises there
